verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents one programmatic interface: an MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp, with documented tools for reading and editing the Model and driving Ari chats, authenticated by OAuth. There is no conventional public REST API: every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404, and no API keys or tokens are issued, so every client must sign in as a person. missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, non-interactive API keys or service accounts, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: AI clients such as Claude Code and Codex can work on your Model through the cfo.ai MCP server.
an agent can read a company's financial Model and, when the user asks, change it: Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, Dimensions
`edit_chats` starts or continues an Ari chat and `inspect_chats` reads Ari's answer.
claude mcp add --transport http cfoai https://api.cfo.ai/mcp
OAuth. A person approves the client in a browser, and the client sends the token it receives in the `Authorization` header.
